headline: Fugro Q3 EBITDA Slumps 30% on Offshore Wind Weakness
summary: Fugro reported a 30% slump in third-quarter EBITDA, citing weakness in the offshore wind sector and higher operating costs.
why: Fugro is a leading Dutch multinational geotechnical data collection and survey specialist serving offshore energy and infrastructure markets.

impacts.name: Fugro
impacts.why: Lower EBITDA figures reflect compressed profit margins and reduced demand in specific operating segments.
